responsibility: Implements the variance module’s test hook by scanning HIR items for the internal `rustc_variance` and crate-level `rustc_variance_of_opaques` attributes, querying each selected item’s inferred variances, and reporting them through diagnostic errors for compiletest-based verification.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `outlives/test.rs`, this test hook is for variance results: it queries `variances_of` and supports both per-item `rustc_variance` and a crate-level `rustc_variance_of_opaques` mode that walks all opaque types. It reports variance vectors rather than formatting inferred outlives predicates.
